description: The line plot illustrates the performance of various methods—Base, MEND, FT, MEMIT, and ROME—on the BioGPT model, measured by accuracy (ACC) in percentage, as a function of the co-occurrence number. The x-axis, labeled "Co-occurrence Number," is plotted on a logarithmic scale ranging from 1 to 1000, with tick marks at 10¹ and 10². The y-axis, labeled "ACC (%)", is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 55. The "Base" method, represented by black circles, starts at approximately 30% accuracy and remains relatively stable, ending at around 33%. The "MEND" method, shown with brown diamonds, begins at about 36% and increases to roughly 45%. The "FT" method, depicted with blue triangles, starts at approximately 34% and rises to about 38%. The "MEMIT" method, indicated by purple squares, begins at around 36% and increases to approximately 46%. The "ROME" method, represented by green squares, starts at about 44% and shows a steady increase, reaching approximately 56%. All methods exhibit an upward trend in accuracy as the co-occurrence number increases.
